integrity: Existing structural classification is cited and excluded from novelty; all new symbolic formulas have explicit proofs and finite checks with stated limits.
scientific_limitations: Odd characteristic only; only abelian subalgebras and abelian ideals; no orbit classification. The underlying Lie algebra, centralizer model and maximal abelian dimension were previously studied. Independent audit and exhaustive historical priority assessment have not been performed.
title: Abelian subalgebra, ideal and closure strata in class-three finite Lie algebras of two breadths
